d: Vibrant crimson hair is styled in a short, layered cut with messy bangs and a single small ponytail on the right side. Sharp, golden-yellow eyes with a focused expression set a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build is dressed in a futuristic white and silver form-fitting bodysuit featuring a plunging neckline, detached sleeves, and an asymmetrical layered skirt with dark grey accents. A single dark metallic horn protrudes from the right side of the head, and the character holds a long, sleek black and silver sword.
